inventory_method: Assess the upstream clsx 2.1.1 runtime source snapshot, not the npm archive or development/build toolchain. Independently fetched package.json declares zero runtime dependencies and src/index.js imports none. Inventory includes clsx itself; devDependencies and build outputs explicitly excluded by SOURCE policy.
